title: source_usage
description: The per-mission log of how external sources were CONSUMED — the provenance record a literary vertical records whenever it queries a corpus, reads a text, or quotes a passage. Each entry names the source, the exact USE (drawn from the registry's allowed_use_vocabulary), the pipeline stage that consumed it, and what output it fed. literary.provenance.validate_usage cross-checks every entry against the source registry: the source must exist, the use must be permitted by its rights, an evidence_citation must carry attribution, and a use that implies ingestion (cite/index/train/redistribute) requires the source to actually be ingested.
